 **Mid\-Level Graphic Designer**

 **AI image generation** 
 to join our creative team and contribute to diverse and exciting projects.

 As a
 **Graphic Designer** 
 at Unstitched, you will play a key role in creating visually compelling designs and branding materials for leading Beauty, FMCG, Automotive, and Fashion brands.
 



 You will use traditional design tools alongside
 **generative AI platforms** 
 to develop original concepts, generate and refine visual assets, accelerate creative exploration, and build campaign\-ready imagery. You will collaborate with our 3D animators, creative directors, and marketing teams to produce high\-quality visuals aligned with our clients’ brand identities and project goals.
 



 Your work will span multiple industries, ensuring every design is innovative, on\-trend, and tailored to its target audience.
   




 Key Responsibilities
 * Create visually striking graphics and layouts for 3D product animations, social media, advertising campaigns, and other marketing materials.
* Use AI image\-generation tools to conceptualize, generate, iterate, and refine high\-quality visual assets.
* Write and optimize effective prompts to achieve specific styles, compositions, lighting, moods, and brand\-aligned results.
* Combine AI\-generated imagery with traditional design techniques, including compositing, retouching, typography, color correction, and image manipulation.
* Maintain visual consistency across AI\-generated assets and ensure outputs meet brand, quality, resolution, and production requirements.
* Collaborate with the creative team to conceptualize and execute design solutions for a wide range of projects.
* Develop brand\-aligned visuals, including logos, typography, color palettes, style frames, and mood boards.
* Create design assets for product animations and integrated marketing campaigns.

* Ensure the responsible use of AI\-generated content, including compliance with applicable brand guidelines, licensing requirements, confidentiality obligations, and intellectual\-property considerations.
* Optimize designs for web, mobile, social media, and other digital platforms.
* Stay updated on design trends, generative AI developments, creative tools, and emerging production techniques.
* Work closely with clients and internal teams to understand project requirements and deliver designs that exceed expectations.
* Manage multiple projects simultaneously while meeting deadlines and maintaining consistently high standards.

**Experience:** 



* 2–4 years of professional graphic design experience, preferably in a creative studio or agency.
* Demonstrable experience using generative AI as part of a professional design workflow.
* A strong portfolio showcasing graphic design, storyboarding, branding, and AI\-generated or AI\-assisted visual work across different industries.



  





**Software and Technical Proficiency:** 



* Adobe Creative Suite, particularly Photoshop, Illustrator, After Effects, and Premiere Pro.
* Hands\-on experience with AI image\-generation platforms such as Midjourney, Adobe Firefly, Stable Diffusion, DALL·E, or comparable tools.
* Understanding of prompt engineering, image\-to\-image workflows, inpainting, outpainting, style development, upscaling, and post\-production.
* Familiarity with AI video\-generation platforms such as Runway or comparable tools.
* Storyboarding tools.
* Figma or other prototyping tools.
* Ability to integrate AI\-generated assets into Photoshop and other production workflows to create polished, commercially usable designs.



  





**Creative and Professional Skills:** 



* Strong understanding of design principles, typography, color theory, composition, and visual hierarchy.
* Ability to maintain character, product, and stylistic consistency across AI\-generated images.
* Experience creating assets for social media and integrated marketing campaigns.
* Strong visual judgment and the ability to distinguish between raw AI output and production\-ready creative work.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast\-paced environment.
* Strong attention to detail and a passion for creating visually impactful designs.
* Curiosity and willingness to continuously explore new AI tools and creative workflows.


 Nice\-to\-Have
 * Knowledge of motion graphics and video editing.
* Experience with AI video generation and AI\-assisted animation workflows.
* Experience training or working with custom AI models, LoRAs, ControlNet, or similar advanced image\-generation workflows.
* Experience working with 3D product animations.
* Familiarity with multiple industries and the ability to adapt designs to different sectors.
* Understanding of copyright, licensing, disclosure, and ethical considerations related to generative AI content.


 What We Offer
 * The opportunity to work on exciting, high\-profile projects across various industries.
* Access to emerging AI tools and the freedom to experiment with new creative workflows.
* A collaborative and creative work environment.
* Professional development opportunities.
* Flexible working hours.



  





  





 Join us at Unstitched and help us redefine visual storytelling through design, AI, CGI, and animation.
 



*Unstitched is an equal\-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.* 




  





**Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for an interview.**

Our main operating offices are located in Singapore, Vancouver, Hong Kong, and Mumbai.
   

  

**Position Description:**
 We are seeking a highly skilled Instructional Designer \& Digital Learning Manager to join our team. In this role, you will bridge the gap between technical maritime engineering, safety compliance, and cutting\-edge digital education. You will be responsible for designing, developing, and deploying highly interactive, high\-retention digital learning modules. Your content will train both shore\-based corporate teams and seafarers deployed globally on our vessels.
   

  

 The ideal candidate understands how adult brains learn and can translate dense technical manuals or safety management systems (SMS) into modern, engaging digital formats optimized for low\-bandwidth and offline environments.
   

  

 We expect the person to be able to liaise with external vendors for quick content development and hence knowledge of industry practices is appreciated.
   

  

 The position is also expected to actively participate in upgrade of our existing Learning Management System and will be responsible for management of the same.

* Technical Translation: Collaborate closely with Subject Matter Experts (SMEs)—including Marine Superintendents, Chief Engineers, and Safety Managers—to convert complex maritime regulations (IMO, MARPOL), engineering blueprints, and operational workflows into clear training content.
* Low\-Bandwidth Optimization: Architect digital packages (SCORM) specifically designed and compressed for smooth deployment on onboard vessel networks and mobile devices with limited internet connectivity.
* Multimedia Production: Script, film, record, and edit high\-quality instructional videos, animations (using Vyond or After Effects), graphic assets, and audio narration.
* Assessment \& Evaluation: Design rigorous, scenario\-based evaluations that measure practical decision\-making and compliance competency, bridging digital learning with onboard physical drills.
* LMS Maintenance: Package and publish courses according to e\-learning standards, ensuring seamless tracking, scoring, and data synchronization with our centralized Crewing and HR systems.


**Requirements:**
* Experience: 3\+ years of experience in instructional design and digital content creation. Experience within maritime, logistics, heavy engineering, aviation, oil \& gas, or defense sectors is highly preferred.

Daily tasks include using tools such as AutoCAD and Tekla Structures/Tekla Structures Designer for modelling, detailing and analysis, coordinating with project managers, architects, and site teams, and reviewing designs for safety, durability, and constructability.
